title: LegalTech
description: Legal skills, community contributions, applications and legal data.

items.title: LegalQuants Plugins
items.desc: Open-source plugins of reusable legal workflows for litigators and transactional lawyers, launched with ChatGPT Enterprise for Astra for Law; I reviewed and contributed to the citation-check and playbook skills.
items.label: view project

items.title: Singapore Legal Research
items.desc: Codex and Claude Code skill for Singapore lawyers that researches and cite-checks from primary authorities, recording versions, pinpoints, contrary authority and gaps.
items.label: view project

items.title: Source-span Extraction
items.desc: Codex and Claude Code skill that extracts fields from legal documents with every value bound to its exact source span, so reviewers verify instead of re-reading.
items.label: view project

items.title: Singapore Clause Drafting
items.desc: Private agent skill that drafts Singapore-law contract clauses from checked research, keeping a traceable drafting note and a precedent library of approved clauses.
items.label: public guide

items.title: PDPA Assessment
items.desc: Codex and Claude Code skill that assesses activities against Singapore's PDPA obligation by obligation, refusing any finding not tied to provision text actually retrieved.
items.label: view project

items.title: Singapore Deadlines
items.desc: Python library, CLI and MCP server that compute Singapore court and contract deadlines from rules as data, with a derivation trace lawyers and AI assistants can check.
items.label: view project

items.title: SAL Citation
items.desc: Next.js workspace for Singapore legal writers that formats SAL-style footnotes, looks up cases on eLitigation and keeps every citation in manuscript order.
items.label: view project

items.title: Copycat
items.desc: Copyright triage workspace for Singapore practitioners: deterministic text and image matching plus 13 evidence-backed legal questions, exported as a report for human review.
items.label: view project

items.title: BART
items.desc: Word add-in for lawyers that checks statutory citations against Singapore Statutes Online using hybrid BM25 and dense retrieval, built with Allen & Overy Shearman.
items.label: view project
items.role: Team Lead · Scrum Master · Software Developer

items.title: LegalBenchmarks.ai
items.desc: Open-access community benchmark giving legal teams evidence on how AI tools perform at drafting, extraction and workflows; I sit on its Steering Committee.
items.label: view project

items.title: sg legal corpus
items.desc: Point-in-time corpus and MCP server that bring Singapore statutes, judgments, PDPC decisions and Hansard under one record shape with provenance; Hansard is live.
items.label: view project

items.title: citecheck
items.desc: Python CLI and Claude skill that audit every citation in a legal draft: extract it deterministically, confirm the authority exists, then check it supports the proposition.
items.label: view project

items.title: chronology
items.desc: Python CLI and Claude skill that turn litigation chronologies into data with mandatory pincites, flagging date conflicts and evidential gaps hand-built tables miss.
items.label: view project

items.title: oblig register
items.desc: Python CLI and Claude skill that turn an executed contract into a dated obligations register with traced deadlines and .ics reminders, so notice windows are not missed.
items.label: view project

items.title: bundlebuild
items.desc: Python CLI and MCP server that builds court bundles from a YAML index, with merged PDFs, page stamps, a hyperlinked index and checks that catch missing exhibits before filing.
items.label: view project

items.title: playbook as code
items.desc: Open YAML schema and Claude skill that turn a legal team's negotiation playbook into data, then review contracts against it to produce a memo and redline-ready changes.
items.label: view project

items.title: ip atlas
items.desc: Python CLI that models cross-border IP protection as cited, versioned data, letting practitioners compare jurisdictions under the law in force at a chosen date.
items.label: view project

items.title: sightstone
items.desc: Next.js platform using Llama 3.3 70B that helps legal teams compare clauses across many contracts and harmonise them into one unified negotiation playbook.
items.label: view project

items.title: pdpc scraper
items.desc: Python toolkit that scrapes PDPC Protection Obligation decisions into Excel and charts penalties and trends for data-protection practitioners.
items.label: view project

items.title: eliti scraper
items.desc: BeautifulSoup scraper that collects reported Singapore Supreme Court judgments from eLitigation into structured data for statistical research on case trends.
items.label: view project

items.title: sg statute scraper
items.desc: Polite Python scraper of Singapore Statutes Online that exports every current Act and its provisions to CSV for legal researchers and NLP pipelines.
items.label: view project

items.title: hansard scraper
items.desc: Python scraper of Singapore Parliament's Hansard API that builds an incremental Excel index and full debate texts for legislative-history research.
items.label: view project

items.title: codeoflaw
items.desc: Python scraper and analysis pipeline that charts reported Singapore Supreme Court judgments by year, judge and catchword for empirical legal research.
items.label: view project

items.title: crimewatch
items.desc: Flask and Leaflet app that scrapes Singapore criminal judgments, scores the locations they mention and maps weighted crime hotspots for legal and policy research.
items.label: view project

items.title: justicegap
items.desc: Leaflet map prototype showing how far Singapore residents are from courts, legal aid and CJCs by legal problem and travel time, to surface access-to-justice gaps.
items.label: view project

items.title: lex lynx
items.desc: Python tool that summarises case-law PDFs with OpenAI or a local Ollama model into Facts, Issues, Holding and Reasoning for faster case reading.
items.label: view project

items.title: tort rat
items.desc: RAG Discord chatbot built on PostgresML and OpenAI that answers Singapore tort law questions from curated case summaries, made for SMU Law of Torts students.
items.label: view project

title: Process modelling & Scrum
description: Model processes, organise delivery and connect reusable capabilities.

items.title: BPMN Workflow Skill
items.desc: Domain-neutral agent skill that generates readable BPMN from a process description and opens it in a local bpmn.io editor to inspect, edit and export.
items.label: view project

items.title: Scrum Skill
items.desc: Codex and Claude Code skill that runs Scrum with AI teammates, from backlog to review and handoff, so a human product owner can deliver bounded work and resume it reliably.
items.label: view project

items.title: Legal Engineering Defined
items.desc: Competence framework and public guide defining what a legal engineer is, demonstrated by a three-layer platform linking process design, capability delivery and matter execution.
items.label: view project

items.title: process modelling & runner
items.desc: Private engine that turns a lawyer's workflow narrative into an inspectable process model and runs released workflows with recorded state and human sign-off gates.
items.label: public guide

title: Agents & personal systems
description: Make agent work visible and build personal working environments.

items.title: PMD Agents
items.desc: VS Code extension that shows developers their running Codex, Claude Code and terminal sessions as Pokémon Mystery Dungeon characters, so agent activity is visible at a glance.
items.label: view project

items.title: Voracity
items.desc: Private React and Firebase workspace that brings my notes, reminders, research tools and a Telegram assistant into one place for daily work.
items.label: private project

items.title: voracity watcher
items.desc: Scheduled GitHub Actions runner for Voracity that watches pages politely, honouring robots.txt, and sends change alerts and briefings to Telegram via Ica.
items.label: view project

title: Other projects
description: Geospatial tools, creative work and earlier experiments.

items.title: apac lateral tracker
items.desc: Zero-cost Python pipeline that extracts partner moves from legal trade press with span-level provenance, giving APAC market analysts precise lateral-hiring trends.
items.label: view project

items.title: hawk shot
items.desc: Python and Streamlit line-of-sight tool that checks whether a target is visible from an observer across DEM terrain, with curvature and refraction correction.
items.label: view project

items.title: map mole
items.desc: Python and Streamlit change-detection tool that aligns two GeoTIFF satellite images and maps what changed, for disaster assessment and map revision.
items.label: view project

items.title: lol pixel art
items.desc: Hand-drawn animated pixel-art renditions of League of Legends skins, including Ashen Knight Pyke, T1 Bard and Fae Dragon Ashe.
items.label: view project

items.title: kevanwee portfolio
items.desc: Next.js portfolio with a playable Pokémon overworld, plus this README garden of Python-rendered animated SVG cards.
items.label: view project

items.title: 3d portfolio
items.desc: three.js portfolio that tours my hobbies and interests through a 3D desk scene full of hidden artefacts to discover.
items.label: view project

items.title: book worm
items.desc: Selenium scraper that looks up book prices by ISBN across Amazon, Kinokuniya and Thryft from a spreadsheet, for comparing prices in bulk.
items.label: view project

items.title: huhh
items.desc: A deliberately misleading portfolio site, built as an April Fools' joke.
items.label: view project
